profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary:
- 20+ years of IT consulting experience.
- 25+ years of software development experience.
- Strong knowledge of Java, JavaScript, C#, and related technologies.
- Critical thinker, detail oriented, organized, analytical, and thorough.
- Consistently and quickly produce quality code.
- Work well with a team and as an individual.
- Quick learner.
- Always striving to learn new technologies.

positions.title: Senior Software Developer/Consultant
positions.description: Various projects as a developer, consultant, and process engineer for companies large and small since August 2006.  Many different types of projects from helping clients successfully overcome issues in their enterprise systems to custom software development.

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description: Member of agile application development team creating a Rails application for appointment scheduling for COVID testing.  Assisted with modifications to the application and underlying database calls to significantly improve performance in key areas to allow the application to service the increased client base due to the pandemic.  Implemented new features, fixed bugs, and updated test suite to fix broken tests and made modification so that tests could be run in parallel.  Laid groundwork for testing based on Cypress.  Made modifications to the application to allow running the components of the application as containerized services on Fargate.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer - iOS
positions.description: Developed a framework to enable rapid development of applications in an Enterprise environment.  The framework frees developers from having to concern themselves with connecting to back end enterprise services by delivering a set of objects to the developer that they can use as part of their domain model while the framework handles the low level details of how to get data back and forth from the backend services.  The client side portion is built using Swift 1.2 on iOS 8 and the backend consists of an asynchronous non-blocking server built using the Spring Framework and various libraries to handle the translation between client requests and responses from the backend services.  Security features include SSL, SSL certificate pinning, and client authentication to the server.  Supports dynamic application configuration via MDM app configuration push.  A Docker container is utilized to allow easy deployment to client sites.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description: Designed and devleoped a configurable sports website for a youth 7v7 football team.  The site is built on NodeJS using the ExpressJS framework as the web framework and various other NodeJS packages for handling sessions, cookies, encryption, images manipulation, file I/O, email, and logging.  The site contains administrative functions that allow dynamic editing of the content within the site.  The UI was created using HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, Bootstrap, Font Awesome, DropZone (drag and drop file uploads), X-editable for inline editing of text within HTML pages, Adobe Illustrator for graphics, and BlueImp Bootstrap Image Gallery for image slideshows.  ImageMagick is used for resizing and manipulating uploaded images.  MongoDB serves as the document store for dynamic website data and holding user sessions.  The Nginx web server is used to allow multiple team sites to be served from a single server, to provide additional security over NodeJS, and to keep with the non-blocking asynchronous I/O architecture of NodeJS.  The entire stack is deployed on an Amazon EC2 instance.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer / iOS Developer
positions.description: Designed and developed an enterprise style demonstrator application on iOS 5.x as part of a small team.  The application uses animated bubble charts to increase the visibility of trends within a given data set.  Extended the core-plot framework along with the use of CoreAnimation to create the animated bubble charts and trails for the chart. Developed a framework to allow a narrative to be created on top of the animation that supports videos, text, or audio to be played at various points of the timeline in order to highlight various points of interest.  Combining the animated charts and annotation framework allowed an engaging story to be told from the data.  The application was tested and developed using behavior driven design with the Kiwi BDD framework.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer / Java Developer
positions.description:
Responsible for implementing, developing applications based on, and supporting applications written on the Boomerang platform as part of a small team.   Boomerang is a proprietary Java based framework for gathering data from disparate data sources and massaging that data into a web based dashboard that is simple and easy to use.  Enhanced the framework to allow for configuration via a Java based web administration console.  Implemented several dashboards and applications for insurance companies, hotels, energy companies, banks, internal projects, and more.  Most projects were based on Struts 2 and Hibernate, running on Apache Tomcat, using MySQL, and Mac OSX or another variant of UNIX as the operating system they are deployed to.  DB2 and SQL Server were also used as the database for some projects.  For visualization of data geographically, Yahoo Maps was frequently used.  For creating charts and graphs JFreeChart and Maani XML/SWF charts were used.  JavaScript/JQuery and AJAX were used to give a more dynamic user experience.

Co-designed and developed a scheduling application for a health diagnostics company to allow them to schedule visits to client sites.  As part of the scheduler, we implemented a system for storing medical test results and allowing the patients to view their results online.  The scheduling application is based on Java running on Apache Tomcat and MySQL using Struts 2 as the web framework and Hibernate as the persistence mechanism.  This application has tremendously improved the ability of the company to sign on new clients.  

Created application for a large hotel company to handle new hire applications by allowing new employees to fill out and print their paperwork online instead of filling out numerous paper forms to reduce errors and streamline the process.  Used Adobe Acrobat Professional and the iText PDF library to create and automatically populate PDF forms running on WebSphere 5.1, SQL Server 2005, and Struts.

positions.title: Owner/IT Consultant
positions.description:
Provide IT consulting services mainly in the area of software development.

Services provided to date include Java development, .NET development, Solr search solutions, iOS development, reverse engineering of business applications, performance analysis/improvement, and business process engineering.

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description: Developer on team focused around ETL and integrations necessary to retire a legacy case management system and make the data available from two case management systems in a unified database to downstream applications and reporting teams.

positions.title: Lead Software Developer
positions.description:
Lead Developer on team focused around ETL and integrations necessary to retire a legacy case management system and make the data available from two case management systems in a unified database to downstream applications and reporting teams.

Reverse engineered and documented legacy case management system to understand how it managed case data in order to transform the data from the current case management system in the same data structure so that reporting teams would not need to change their reporting queries.

Provided developers and product teams with necessary information and guidance to build an ETL application for migrating and transforming the data into a unified database while maintaining data integrity to ensure accurate reports. Successfully built and released to production.

Led creation and deployment of system to provide downstream enterprise alerting system with notifications when significant changes to cases occurred so users could be notified of the changes.

Led development and deployment of a staff management application to unify user staff data between multiple systems into one and provide administration capabilities as well as expose the data to other systems for use in other projects and reports via REST API and DMS.

Applications are based on Java, Spring Boot, Angular, and Postgres.  Used various AWS services such as SNS/SQS, Aurora/RDS, ECS, Fargate, EC2, ECR, Lambdas, DMS, IAM, Parameter Store, and more.

positions.title: Lead Software Developer
positions.description: Dev team lead for integrations portion of case management system called RCM.  Responsible for development of new integrations with other systems such as document management and reference data.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Member of Regulatory Case Management team which is responsible for development of an application and services to manage and track cases related to regulatory matters in the financial industry.

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description: Containerized and upgraded Telecom Service Management application from Rails 4.2 to Rails 6.1. Converted application while ensuring functionality and tests pass through each major/minor version of Rails between 4.2 and 6.1.  Migrated database from Postgres 9 to 13 in AWS RDS.  Built AWS environment for running application on ECS Fargate with database on RDS, messaging via SNS/SQS, email via SES, and DNS services via Route53.

positions.title: Senior Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
Designed, developed, and integrated a replacement pricing engine to help bring pricing consistency and accuracy to the company’s service applications which price automotive services sold by dealership service departments.  Worked closely with several application teams to implement the pricing solution into their service applications.  Created an audit framework to capture each change that occurs to the price of a service as well as provide a trace of how the price of each service was calculated.  Built in C# .NET 4.7 using Moq, FluentAssertions, and Nspec for unit testing.  Heavy use of WebAPI and LLBLGenPro within the integration tier.  Source control via TFS and also Git in VSTS (Azure DevOps).

Implemented an auditing solution for Service applications based on .NET Framework 4.7 in C# with a RabbitMQ message bus in order to allow asynchronous processing of audit events to enable users to continue within the applications without waiting and to lighten the load on the database.

Created REST specifications in OpenAPI for administration and functional aspects of multi-point inspections within the company's centralized services platform called Fortellis.  Developed implementation of MPI specifications in C# .NET Core 3.1 and 5 using Entity Framework Core 3 and 5 with a Postgres database.

Helped transition from Selenium to CypressJS for automation testing and mentored QA on how to structure and write Cypress tests.

Provided guidance to team on development best practices, git usage, testing, and other development activities.

Assisted with troubleshooting production issues through in depth analysis of data via custom SQL queries and tracing/debugging code to determine root cause of many issues throughout the engagement.

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description: Part of agile development team designing and implementing an Alexa skill to assist real estate agents organize their day and find information about listings and other real estate information relevant to them. Utilized many facets of AWS including Lambda functions, RDS, ElastiCache (Memcached), Code Pipeline, CodeDeploy, and IAM.  Built features and functionality in NodeJS using WebStorm as the IDE and Git for source control.  Refactored project to dynamically discover and load new intents to help make it easier to add new intents to the skill for more rapid development.  Implemented framework for handling multi-turn dialogs.  Introduced a templating library for handling speech output in a more consistent and understandable way via HandlebarsJS.  Introduced memcached via AWS Elasticache to improve performance of requests for the same data in a short period of time.  Helped set standards for logging.  Integrated with Google Calendar API's and Azure TimeZone API's.  Pulled data from existing Realogy Web API's directly and from Postgres database hosted on RDS as the source data for the skill.  Participated in daily stand-ups, reviewing pull requests, grooming, sprint demos, and retrospectives.

positions.title: Senior Software Consultant
positions.description: Provided technical guidance, architectural oversight, and wrote/modified software for the company's printing system for billing.  Evaluated performance and functional issues with existing printing software and re-architected/re-wrote the software that is run at all billing centers to print thousands of bills daily.  Wrote solution in C# .NET 4.6 using multi-threaded techniques in order to improve performance and scalability for downloading files that need to be printed as well as printing to multiple printers in parallel.  Used BDD techniques to drive development and testing of the software using the NSpec testing framework.  In addition, identified and fixed multiple critical performance and functionality issues with the backend TIBCO BusinessWorks processes and associated Oracle database as well as performance issues with their Paris server which serves as the PDF generation engine which ultimately feeds the files printed by the billing center print processors.  This involved providing solutions and guidance to developers on how to fix business processes in TIBCO, creating foreign keys, indexes, functions, and tables in the database, and performing various tests to identify performance issues and implement solutions to fix the performance issues.  Wrote numerous custom functions to augment the TIBCO XPath library to make it easier to both write and maintain the TIBCO business processes.  Updated and added documentation to project Confluence pages to bring the outdated documentation in line with current state.  Assisted the team in troubleshooting and testing daily by investigating root cause for issues that were found during QA.  Assisted dev ops in the deployment of the print processor via Bamboo.  Updated portions of the web administration tool which was written in AngularJS using a Java backend to connect to TIBCO REST services written in BusinessWorks.  Integrated Java based file transfer library called FDT to transfer files to billing centers faster.

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description: Full stack developer creating solutions and features for a multi-tenant telecom application that helps telecom agents manage their customers telecom services.  Part of small agile team of 3-4 developers.  Regular meetings with the customer to continually understand their needs and improve the product.  Development using Ruby on Rails and AngularJS with a Postgres database and deployment to EC2 instances in an AWS VPC.  Wrote thousands of feature, integration, and unit tests using RSpec, Capybara, and PhantomJS using BDD style syntax.  Using RubyMine IDE and Git, Github, SourceTree for source control.

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description: Back-end developer on Agile development team building a next generation web-based point of sale system based on AngularJS and .Net 4.5.  Built web services based on .NET WebAPI 2 which consisted of the WebAPI endpoints, a service layer below that, and a set of repositories making use of EntityFramework 6.x to retrieve and persist data to an Oracle database.  Laid foundation for rules engine based on NRules to handle business rule logic.  NUnit was used for unit and integration testing.  Development was done using Visual Studio 2015.  Utilized Visual Studio Online for scrum board (stories, tasking, defects), story pointing, builds, and pull requests.  Development consisted of creating a point of sale system to handle origination and servicing of payday and installment loans across various states with complex rules varying by state.  Required detailed analysis of existing system and data in order to ensure functionality remained consistent and business and state rules were enforced by the newly developed code.  Worked closely with business analysts, product owner, and other development team members to deliver a quality product while maintaining backwards compatibility with existing systems that shared the same Oracle database.  In addition, brought Solr search capabilities to the system by creating a search engine that would allow customers to be looked up in a "Google" like fashion versus the traditional search which required searching by a specific field.  This included creating a bulk import utility which loaded millions of customers into Solr using via multiple threads to complete the job in a short amount of time.  This utility also supported the ability to perform incremental imports into Solr.  Analysis and development to create a performance test suite using JMeter to simulate production load and real world scenarios.  Ran capacity, load, stress, and endurance tests and provided comprehensive analysis and documentation based on performance testing results.

positions.title: IT Consultant
positions.description: Designed, implemented, and deployed Apache Solr search engine solution to replace existing mobile inventory search backend solution.  Achieved dramatically improved search relevancy and performance using a five server cluster of Solr and Zookeeper instances on SolrCloud 5.  Architected and deployed development, test, and production environments.  Defined JMX and server system level monitoring implemented on Solarwinds.  Performed performance testing by writing a custom test runner in JMeter for capacity, load, stress, and endurance testing.  Tuned Solr instances based on performance results.  Wrote various Bash shell scripts to automate customized Solr/Zookeeper installation, enable remote start/stop of the cloud and individual instances, start data imports, and run various Solr commands to ease use and maintenance.  Discovered and patched Zookeeper JMX bug which was committed back to the open source project.  Created a project in Git with Maven as the build tool in order to create a customized installation, scripts, and configuration for the client.  Created architecture, installation, management, monitoring, testing, and other technical documentation.  Prepared PowerPoint presentation and presented to executive management.

positions.title: IT Consultant
positions.description: Discovery and analysis of the Cash America overnight reporting processes.  Created diagram of the Tivoli Workload Scheduler (TWS) landscape to help organization better understand what is currently running in production, when jobs run, how long they run, and identify potential issues and opportunities in various scenarios (weekday, weekend, month end).  Identified areas for improvement and investigation within the TWS schedule.  Performed analysis of shell scripts and Oracle PL/SQL packages to provide an overview and recommendations for improving various jobs orchestrated by TWS.  A majority of these jobs run against an operational data store (ODS), a replication of the ODS, and a Data Warehouse running Oracle 10g and 11g.

positions.title: Process Engineer / Consultant
positions.description: Worked as a process engineer on Chase's next generation loan origination platform helping to ensure an efficient and sound business process.  Assisted the business in developing requirements for many projects by providing process expertise to ensure requirements were solid and fit well within the overall loan lifecycle.   Developed process flow diagrams in Microsoft Visio working with business subject matter experts and business analysts to create process maps for various projects, audit, training, and procedures.  Created process mapping standards and a system for creating maps by release in order to help provide a manageable map set and production of consistent maps across process engineers.  Co-developed a tagging system within the maps to automatically parse the maps via software written in Java for data related to organizational handoffs and outstanding questions and outputting the data into Excel using Apache POI.  Became a high value team member with a high level of knowledge and assigned to the more complex projects.  Often specifically requested for projects by project managers and business analysts due to a track record of responsiveness, analytical skills, quick delivery, and quality shown on other projects.  Consistently juggled ten or more concurrent projects. Involved with requirements gathering, requirements reviews, agile story grooming, functional test scenario development, quality assurance test scenario development, and user acceptance demos for each project to ensure the integrity of the process was not compromised and to document any changes necessary along the way. During this time I was involved with a diverse set of projects within the mortgage originations space revolving around lending regulations (Dodd Frank, RESPA/TILA), government products (FHA, VA), mortgage products, retail, consumer direct, integrations with third-party systems, system enhancements, and hiring.  Mentored several new hires around process and job functions.

positions.title: IT Consultant
positions.description: Performed analysis of in-house portal framework built on BEA WebLogic Portal and Oracle Coherence to allow integration of all applications across the organization.  The Spring Framework was used extensively within the framework.  Work completed included code analysis, architecture analysis, performance testing, and coherence/portal configuration tuning to optimize throughput to handle anywhere from hundreds to thousands of requests per second.  Provided recommendations for static resource distribution, optimizing CMIS query performance, virtual content repository (VCR) caching, handling dynamic CMIS queries, and scaling the VCR to meet future demand.  In addition, examined code for improvement opportunities and fixes to code/architecture that could pose potential issues in the future.  Directed testing efforts to identify VCR performance bottlenecks and to test benefits of configuration changes or other recommendations.  Recommendations were made based on data collected from LoadRunner, HP Monitoring, JConsole, WebLogic Admin Console, and log files (Weblogic, Coherence, and the custom built framework).

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer / IT Consultant
positions.description: Member of small team responsible for data integration of various data feeds between Barclays UK, Barclays US, AnalogAnalytics, and Cheetahmail.  Developed software written in Java to securely import data from an SFTP server in the form of CSV and DAT files into a MySQL database.  Used PGP encryption to encrypt and decrypt files.  Utilized Java’s support for threaded execution via Executors and Tasks in order to process very large amounts of data quickly.  Setup Jenkins server and build jobs for continuous integration of the data integration code stored on Github.  Wrote tests using Cucumber for Java using behavior driven design and testing techniques to develop and test the data integration code.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer / IT Consultant
positions.description: Greatly improved the performance, scalability, and usability for a software application used by Nationstar employees to select loan products, generate loan applications, and provide product data to third party vendors.  Used JProfiler to aid in identifying performance issues.  Implemented and improved second level caching and query caching in the application via Hibernate and EhCache.  Created JMeter test plans to simulate constant and stepped load running on Amazon EC2 instances to simulate production level hardware.  Exceeded customer targets for scalability and performance.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer / IT Consultant
positions.description: Reverse engineered a loan origination system purchased from a 3rd party that was written in Progress OpenEdge ABL containing over 10 million lines of code.  Created technical documentation to describe how various pieces of the software architecture worked as well as detailed analysis of code as it related to the system use cases of interest to the firm.  Created tool in ABL to automatically determine all possible paths (100k+) through the menu system in order to find security holes.  Created various other tools such as a line of code counter and code complexity analyzer in Java to aid in the analysis of the Progress code.

positions.title: IT Consultant/Technical Lead
positions.description:
Conducted analysis of the bank’s treasury management software in order to identify potential areas where performance could be elevated to improve the customer experience.  The application consists of a Java web application on JRun 4 behind IIS on Windows Server 2003, an application server running C++ on AIX 5.3 with WebSphere MQ 6.0 and Tuxedo 8.1, and an Oracle 9i database server.  Analyzed database queries, data model, source code, environment, memory usage, mainframe interaction, and other key areas to provide recommendations to boost performance.  Software vendor made modifications to the application based on recommendations provided.  

Stabilized the application and production environments across all tiers of the treasury management application due to a history of poor uptime.  Implemented monitoring of key business functions via SiteScope and Real User Monitoring.  Created various batch and shell scripts to aid monitoring and stabilization efforts. 

Resolved production support issues for the treasury management application.  Worked with various internal IT teams and the application vendor to resolve issues in a timely manner.   Evolved into the subject matter expert for treasury management platform.

Provided day-to-day technical expertise to management and other IT personnel.   Involved with providing technical recommendations and performing IT related needs such as monitoring, writing maintenance scripts, performing installations, troubleshooting, providing estimates, reporting, sizing, etc.

During a bank conversion project I provided validation of converted data, technical support to various teams working together during the conversion, reports to management and teams, ad-hoc queries for additional information as requested, troubleshooting, and performed server startup and shutdown procedures.

positions.title: Creator/Webmaster
positions.description:
Website created and maintained by a friend and I that allows home brewers to post and manage their recipes, maintain notes on brews, create FAQ’s on their recipes, export their recipes as PDF’s and interact with other brewers.  

The web application utilized Java 5, JSP, Servlets, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, AJAX, Struts2, iText, Hibernate, MySQL, and Tomcat on Mac OSX running on a server that was maintained from my home office.  The site was integrated with Google Ads and the Amazon Store.

positions.title: IT Consultant
positions.description:
Brought onto a high visibility project for expertise in BEA WebLogic Integration in order to increase throughput for this piece of software which required high transaction rates.  The software is responsible for determining which credit card offers to present to millions of customers.  

Implemented caching using OSCache to eliminate unnecessary round trips to the database and modified code to improve the efficiency of XMLBeans in WebLogic Java Process Definitions (JPD’s) within WebLogic Integration.  Wrote various test programs to test performance of business processes and database code.   Achieved target performance objectives set by the customer.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Key member of team that designed and implemented a prototype that led to a large multi-contractor integration project known as DCGS-N.  Played crucial role in the design and implementation of the J2EE, web-based, enterprise integration application.  Wrote requirements, interface documentation, and system architecture diagrams.  Implemented business process automation in the system using WebLogic Integration 8.1 to enable intelligent processing of events and data in order to kick-off processes automatically and pre-position data to gain situational awareness for military personnel in the field.  Involved with the implementation and testing of all aspects of the application using JSP’s, Servlets, EJB’s, JMS, Web Services, and JDBC deployed on WebLogic 8.1.  Installed software stack and performed troubleshooting activities at customer site.  Frequently performed duties and responsibilities of project engineer and software lead when they were unavailable.  Participated in change control board meetings to approve changes to go into releases.  Held Top Secret DoD Security Clearance.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description: Created a new company website for the startup to improve presentation and add functionality to improve customer experience.  Improved search engine ranking to top 10 on major search engines such as Yahoo, Google, Excite, and Lycos.  Created Perl scripts to monitor web sites to ensure uptime and simulate user interaction to ensure site functionality is working as expected.  The scripts simulate user interaction through the site via various online forms, the most common of which were shopping cart type interactions for large and small retail companies.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description: Built and setup company desktop computers and network for startup.  Created Perl scripts and HTML pages for company web site.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer - iOS

The client side portion is built using Swift 1.2 on iOS 8 and the backend consists of an asynchronous non-blocking server built using the Spring Framework and various libraries to handle the translation between client requests and responses from the backend services.
